browser.note: server override: <instance>/browser.json {"profile_dir": "/home/ecs-user/sd_crawler/liaoning/state/server_browser_profile"}; Chrome stays owned by liaoning-browser-owner.service (never stop it: its driver closes Chrome)

work_page.name: pmos-liaoning-work
work_page.note: the portal plus legacy worker pages stay open; PMOS opens its own column page from the portal with window.open (inherits sessionStorage natively), as the legacy cold start did

memory_guard.note: Chrome, its owner and driver; per-machine override in <instance>/browser.json

page_recycle.note: Liaoning: same-site pages grew to 1.8 GB over 6 days (Blink GC, not reclaimable by forced GC); only a fresh page frees it

renderer_alert.note: an event (renderer_heavy) for the province session; the page itself is recycled by page_recycle

policy.note: User 2026-11-04: 0.5 s after every response, one shared serial worker. Liaoning production (2026-10-31): 1 s after each response on every serial lane (user 21:05); keepalive after 300 s idle; a denial or an unknown result pauses only that source and is never re-sent; 429 / auth stop the province; 2 empty periods in a row pause the dataset; business pauses below 2 GB free disk (root disk 40 GB, 5.6 GB free on 10-31)

session.keepalive_period_note: A fixed, proven day: PMOS's archive holds no system_load until its first new day is due, and keep_session could send nothing (2026-11-01). The legacy raw record of this day has all 96 points

release.policy_reference: 2026-10-27 retained authorization records; never applied to production
